title: How to take medicines
body: Give medicines at the same time every day. Do not skip doses.
bullets: Take after food if the doctor said so
Keep medicines in a cool dry place
If a dose is missed, ask the doctor — do not double dose

title: Simple diet tips
body: Eat home-cooked food. Reduce sugar, salt, and fried snacks.
bullets: Drink clean water through the day
Prefer vegetables, dal, and whole grains

title: Gentle exercise
body: A short daily walk helps recovery. Rest if chest pain or dizziness starts.
bullets: Walk 20–30 minutes if the doctor allows
Stop and sit if breathing becomes hard

title: Warning signs to watch
body: Contact the health worker or doctor early if problems grow.
bullets: Sugar or BP readings staying very high

title: Why follow-up matters
body: Follow-up visits catch problems early and keep recovery on track.
bullets: Bring medicine list and recent readings
Do not stop medicines without advice
Tell the doctor about new symptoms

title: Emergency symptoms
body: Go to the nearest hospital or call 108 for these signs.
bullets: Very high fever with stiffness or bleeding
